overloads.semanticRole: Creates a new empty in-memory record for a table (without displaying it), for programmatic field assignment rather than interactive data entry.

constraints: The new record becomes the current record, but the current selection is left untouched.
The record only exists in memory until SAVE RECORD is called for the table; if the current record changes before saving (e.g. via a query), the new record is lost.
Does not require aTable to be in read/write mode; it can be used even when the table is read-only.
